column1: # SUMMARY: We are requesting a gene microarray analysis for 10 cell lines that are pertinent to human non-small lung cancer. A main focus of ours has been the role that Sulf-2 plays in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Sulf-2 is an extracellular sulfatase that acts on internal glucosamine-6-sulfates within heparan sulfate chains. Sulf-2 can activate Wnt signaling
column2: as well as modulate other signaling pathways. Our recent work (Oncogene 29:635
column3: 2010) has shown that Sulf-2 is required for the malignant phenotype of five human NSCLC cell lines (increased migration
column4: increased growth
